definitions.explanation: A state of being easily moved to tender, sad, or nostalgic emotions. Can imply excessive or self-indulgent emotion.

examples.japanese: {感傷|かんしょう}に{浸|ひた}る。
{感傷|かんしょう}に{流|なが}されずに{冷静|れいせい}に{判断|はんだん}する。
examples.english: Judge calmly without being swept away by sentimentality.

examples.japanese: {卒業|そつぎょう}シーズンは{誰|だれ}もが{感傷|かんしょう}{的|てき}になる。
examples.english: Everyone gets sentimental during graduation season.

notes:
{感傷|かんしょう} refers to tender, nostalgic emotions.

NUANCE:
- Can be neutral (natural emotional sensitivity)
- Can be slightly negative (excessive, self-indulgent emotion)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {感傷|かんしょう}に{浸|ひた}る: to indulge in sentimentality
- {感傷|かんしょう}に{流|なが}される: to be swept away by sentiment
- {感傷|かんしょう}{的|てき}: sentimental (na-adjective)
- {感傷|かんしょう}{主義|しゅぎ}: sentimentalism

RELATED WORDS:
- {郷愁|きょうしゅう}: nostalgia, homesickness
- {哀愁|あいしゅう}: sorrow, melancholy
